title: AI-powered data development: How agentic SDLC & dbt-MCP transformed our data engineering workflow
description:
How Zendesk doubled its analytics engineering capacity with Claude Code and the dbt MCP server. From dbt Summit 2026.

Explore dbt Summit 2026 and watch more sessions: https://www.getdbt.com/dbt-summit

Suhas Jangoan and Ayan Putatunda, data engineers at Zendesk, show how connecting Claude Code to the dbt MCP server gave the agent real project context, lineage, tests, and metadata across a 1,000-plus-model project. A 20% human error rate in model promotion dropped to zero, and promotion-and-validation cycle time fell by more than 90%. An internal AI Skills Library with review, governance, and evaluation layers let an eight-person team effectively double its capacity.

In this session you'll learn:
• How the dbt MCP server gives AI agents governed project context
• How to build an AI Skills Library with review and evaluation layers
• How Zendesk eliminated model promotion errors

Speakers: Suhas Jangoan, senior data engineer, and Ayan Putatunda, staff data engineer, Zendesk

Learn more about dbt and AI: https://www.getdbt.com/product/ai
